where: Galehigh Terraces (the kite-strung cliff town outdoors + the Skyloft; returns after the Kite-rising)
mood: Updraft — giddy, wind-buffeted propulsion on the cliff-farms, kites snapping overhead in the last fire-light before the climb.
core_styles: bright staccato pulse-wave lead that springs up on the downbeat and skips back down
fast flickering broken-triad arpeggio shimmering above like a kite tail
driving synth bass walking in steady eighths
brisk kick and snare with ticking hi-hat sixteenths
white-noise wind gust swells that rise and cut every four bars
high-altitude cliff-town overworld theme, wind and kites at sunset

sections.name: Intro
sections.text: {a bold, bright opening call: a wind gust swells up, the lead fires a quick rising kite-hop fanfare in D major over a snare pickup, cutting to a held chord that launches straight into the theme}

sections.name: Main Theme
sections.text: {the hook front-loaded in the first two bars: a staccato rising leap that overshoots and lands on a cheeky offbeat, then skips stepwise back home; bass driving, arpeggio flickering above}

sections.name: Main Theme Reprise
sections.text: {the same hook again, fuller: a bright bell counter-line answers each hop, a gust swell crests at the half and cuts on the downbeat}

sections.name: Bridge
sections.text: {contrast: half-time feel over B minor and G major, longer soaring lead notes leaning into the wind, the arpeggio climbing like a kite on its string, building back toward A}

sections.name: Main Theme Return
sections.text: {the hook returns at full energy with drums driving; the last bar rides a snare fill up to A that springs straight back into the main theme}
